# semaphore_ex_project_user (Data Source)

The project user data source allows you to read a User's role in a project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "semaphore_ex_project_user" "user" {
  project_id = 1
  user_id    = 3
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project.
- `user_id` (Number) The ID of the user.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Display name of the user.
- `revision` (Number) Current membership revision used for optimistic concurrency control.
- `role` (String) Role of the user in the project.
- `role_id` (String) Server-resolved custom role ID; empty for built-in roles.
- `username` (String) Username of the user.
